Routes your apps' model calls through Cloudflare AI Gateway in your account, for logs, caching and analytics. Your keys stay on your Gateway.

## Turn it on

1. Run `everyapp ai gateway on`. It creates an AI Gateway named `everyapp` in your account, or reuses it.
2. Optional: to require a token, turn on **Settings → Authenticated Gateway** in the AI Gateway dashboard, create a token, and run `everyapp secret set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`.

**Check it worked:** `everyapp secret list` lists `AI_GATEWAY_ID`, and the AI Gateway dashboard shows your apps' calls.

## More help

Ask your coding agent to set Cloudflare AI Gateway up: the everyapp skill has the full guide ([`setup/ai-gateway.md`](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/blob/main/packages/cli/skills/everyapp/setup/ai-gateway.md)).
